trial.chip.label: Trial, {credits, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} left, ends {date}
trial.summary.title: Free trial
trial.summary.left: {remaining, number} of {credits, number} trial credits left
trial.summary.note: Trial credits run a few fast models with images up to {image} and video up to {video}, {seconds, number}s. Pick a plan for every model, higher resolutions and top-ups.
trial.plan.value.active: {remaining, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} left
trial.plan.text.active: Ends {date}. Started with {credits, number} credits for fast image and video models, plus planning with the agent.
trial.plan.text.used: You’ve used your trial credits. Pick a plan to keep generating. Your projects stay as they are.
trial.plan.text.expired: Your trial ended {date}. Pick a plan to keep generating. Your projects stay as they are.
trial.plan.limits: Images up to {image}, video up to {video} and {seconds, number}s, exports up to {export}p, the agent with DeepSeek. No team, top-ups or mature content.
trial.plan.agent: Agent use: {used, number, ::percent} of the trial allowance
trial.onboarding.label: Get started
trial.onboarding.kind.title: What do you make?
trial.onboarding.kind.sub: This picks where to start. You can make anything later.
trial.onboarding.start.title: Start from a template or a brief
trial.onboarding.start.sub: A template comes with its shots laid out. A brief goes to the agent, which plans the shots for you to approve.
trial.onboarding.start.noTemplates: No templates for this yet. Write a brief instead.
trial.onboarding.brief.ads: A 10-second ad for a reusable water bottle, morning light by a river, upbeat
trial.onboarding.brief.drama: A 15-second scene: two friends argue over the last slice of pizza, then laugh
trial.onboarding.brief.talking: A presenter shares three tips for better sleep, friendly tone, vertical
trial.onboarding.brief.social: A 10-second vertical clip of coffee being poured in slow motion
trial.onboarding.result.title: See the result
trial.onboarding.result.sub: Nothing runs until you approve it, and every run shows its cost first.
trial.onboarding.result.credits: Your trial has {remaining, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} until {date}.
trial.onboarding.result.template: {name} opens in Quick Create. Swap in your own details, then run it. The result shows up there and in Activity.
trial.onboarding.result.brief: Your brief goes into the prompt box on Home. Send it and the agent plans the shots; run them to see the result.
